EXAMPLE FINANCIAL CORP.
ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT
FISCAL YEAR 2025

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Example Financial Corp. provides financial technology services to
institutional and retail customers. During fiscal year 2025, the
company expanded its digital payment platform and increased the
number of active customers.

Revenue increased significantly during fiscal year 2025. Management
attributed the increase primarily to higher transaction volumes and
growth in subscription services.

RISK FACTORS

The company operates in a highly regulated financial environment.
Changes in financial regulations may increase compliance costs and
could affect the company's operating results.

The company is also exposed to cybersecurity and operational risks.
A significant disruption to critical systems could negatively affect
customers and financial performance.

MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

Total revenue for fiscal year 2025 was $42.8 billion compared with
$38.1 billion in fiscal year 2024.

Operating expenses were $31.4 billion in fiscal year 2025. Operating
expenses increased by approximately 6.2% compared with the prior
year.

Net income was $5.2 billion in fiscal year 2025 compared with
$4.4 billion in fiscal year 2024.

FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Income Statement

Revenue                         $42.8 billion
Operating Expenses              $31.4 billion
Net Income                       $5.2 billion

Balance Sheet

Total Assets                    $185.6 billion
Total Liabilities               $142.3 billion
Shareholders' Equity             $43.3 billion

NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Revenue recognition policies are applied consistently across the
company's major operating segments.

Certain financial estimates require management judgment. Actual
results may differ from these estimates due to changes in market
conditions, customer behavior, and regulatory requirements.
